Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Obfuscation

No evidence of malware-like supply-chain behavior was identified.

  • The API/FTP/IMAP/HTTP calls appear consistent with the package’s integration-library purpose. No pattern was found of harvesting developer/CI credentials and sending them to attacker-controlled infrastructure.
  • ZIP-related references appear to be file parsing/error handling (BadZipFile) or extension handling, not staging of harvested secrets into archives.
  • No evidence was found for cron/systemd/launch agent/shell profile persistence, Kubernetes/CI/cloud lateral movement, persistence installation, or stealth loaders in the provided text.
